class.name: AudioVoiceAdmissionPlanner
class.brief_description: Bounded, data-only admission policy for positional audio voices.
class.description: Evaluates at most 128 voice metadata dictionaries without creating or playing audio nodes. Each voice dictionary contains a nonempty [code]name[/code], finite numeric [code]audibility[/code] in dB, finite nonnegative [code]age[/code] in seconds, and optional priority 0–3. Results use -2 for a free slot, -1 to reject the newcomer, or a zero-based index for the selected old voice. Same-name caps take precedence over global caps. Lower-priority, quieter voices are selected first, with older age breaking nearly equal volume ties. [method select_victim_stable] optionally protects the initial attack of very young sounds, inspired by Unreal Engine Sound Concurrency retrigger and voice-resolution policies. This affects only audio presentation and never changes server gameplay events.

method.name: select_victim
method.description: Original priority, audibility and age based admission. Existing projects retain unchanged semantics.

method.name: select_victim_stable
method.description: Same caps and priority order as [method select_victim], except an existing voice younger than [param min_voice_age] seconds cannot be stolen by an equal- or lower-priority sound unless the new sound has equal priority and is at least [param early_override_db] dB louder. A higher-priority sound can always steal a lower-priority voice irrespective of age. Picks the weakest eligible victim, keeping the per-name concurrency limit. If no eligible voice exists, returns -1; a free slot returns -2 regardless of age. The values must be finite, with min_voice_age in 0–5 seconds and early_override_db in 0–60 dB; invalid arguments reject without changing the existing voices. Setting min_voice_age to zero restores legacy behavior exactly. This class does not play, fade, or virtualize audio: callers must handle stopping their chosen victim.
